title: Reporting Analyst, Workday Reporting
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

The People & Purpose Reporting Services Analyst will be a key member of the People Operations team, providing Workday Reporting support for all employees Join our People & Purpose Reporting Services team, part of People Operations, where we help every employee and manager across Workday get the data they need. We work side-by-side with our People & Purpose Centers of Excellence — Recruiting, Talent Experience, Total Rewards, HR Partners, Learning, Compliance, Belonging and Diversity, and Global Mobility — to close gaps in data and build reports that help our leaders make informed, real-time decisions. We also build self-service tools so our partners can find answers faster on their own. If you enjoy connecting the dots across many parts of HR and turning complex data into something people can act on, you'll feel right at home here.

**About the Role**

As a **Reporting Analyst** , you will be the person people turn to when they need HR data they can rely on, whether that's building a new report, updating an existing one, or digging into a one-off question. You will own high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests from start to finish, helping requesters shape raw data into a clear story they can bring to their own audience. This role touches nearly every area of HR, including recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers, so you will build broad knowledge of how HR data connects across the business. You will also look for ways to make reporting simpler and more enjoyable for everyone who relies on it.
  
In this role, you will:

* Respond to HR data requests spanning recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers
* Be responsible for audits requested by any team across the business, ensuring the underlying data is accurate, complete, and compliant
* Build new reports and update or troubleshoot existing ones in Workday
* Provide attentive, high-touch support for high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests, helping requesters interpret and present their data
* Apply strong data security, accuracy, governance, and standardization practices to every report you deliver
* Prioritize and manage a high volume of requests with competing deadlines
* Create self-service resources that help HR partners find answers faster on their own

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in HR reporting, analytics, or a related data role
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday Reporting (Workday HCM experience is a plus)

**Other Qualifications**

* Able to turn complex HR data into a clear story that helps business leaders make decisions
* Skilled at cleaning, organizing, and combining data from multiple HR systems, with strong attention to data security, accuracy, and governance
* Broad knowledge of HR functions and terminology across areas such as recruiting, total rewards, learning, and compliance
* Attentive and responsive when supporting internal customers, even under tight deadlines
Organized and able to juggle multiple requests and deadlines in a high-volume environment  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.

  

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

  

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible.

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.

Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.

In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

title: Staff Inbound Product Manager – Platform and AI Innovation Solutions

title: I&P-GN - SONG-MT-DSMS-Customer Lifecycle Campaign- Retail-Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**

The I&P Global Network Song practice works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions, providing transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. You will own customer lifecycle engagement and campaign transformation workstreams for clients across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms, and Life Sciences. This is a workstream ownership role: you carry the client relationship for your track, lead a team of consultants, and are accountable for the commercial outcomes of the campaigns and journeys you design. You translate growth, retention and loyalty ambitions into segmented, decisioning-driven lifecycle interventions and prove the value they create.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Customer Lifecycle Strategy:**
* Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle framework - acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, cross-sell, upsell, retention, loyalty, renewal and win-back.
* Define customer segmentation and treatment strategies across lifecycle stage, value tier, behavioural profile, propensity, risk and engagement level.
* Own the campaign calendar and prioritisation across a complex, multi-channel environment, balancing commercial objectives, customer relevance, contact policy and regulatory requirements.
* **Next Best Action & Personalisation:**
* Translate business objectives into Next Best Action and Next Best Offer strategies - eligibility, suitability, applicability and prioritisation logic.
* Work with decisioning, data and martech teams to define engagement policies, arbitration rules, contact policy and suppression frameworks.
* Drive the shift from batch campaign execution to trigger-based, event-driven, real-time and always-on engagement.
* **Industry-Specific Growth & Retention Programmes:**
* Retail: Design lifecycle programmes that drive repeat purchase, purchase frequency, basket growth, loyalty participation, category expansion, omnichannel conversion and customer retention.
* Financial Services: Design onboarding, activation, product adoption, cross-sell, wallet-share, servicing, retention and lifetime-value programmes while accounting for consent, suitability and regulatory controls.
* Software & Platforms: Drive onboarding completion, feature adoption, free-to-paid conversion, usage expansion, subscription renewal, churn prevention and reactivation across user and account lifecycles.
* Life Sciences: Shape compliant HCP and patient engagement journeys, including HCP education, patient support programme enrolment, adherence, persistence and omnichannel engagement, in partnership with medical, legal and regulatory stakeholders.
* **Journey & Channel Orchestration:**
* Design omnichannel journeys across email, SMS, mobile app, push notifications, web, ecommerce, digital media, contact centre, sales and assisted channels.
* Translate customer behaviours, transactions and business events into automated lifecycle journeys and timely interventions.
* Optimise channel mix, cadence, content relevance and customer experience across touchpoints.
* **Generative AI in Customer Engagement:**
* Identify and land GenAI use cases across campaign planning, brief development, audience intelligence, content generation, personalisation and performance summarisation.
* Define quality, brand, compliance and human-review guardrails for AI-generated customer communication, with controls appropriate to regulated industries.
* **Measurement & Optimisation:**
* Own lifecycle performance measurement across acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, loyalty, renewal and customer lifetime value.
* Lead the test-and-learn agenda - control group design, A/B and multivariate testing, and incremental value attribution.
* Present performance read-outs and optimisation recommendations to client marketing and business leadership.
* **Team & Delivery Management:**
* Lead and coach a team of consultants and analysts; review and sign off on campaign strategy, journey design, build quality and reporting.
* Manage workstream plans, dependencies, risks and client expectations across marketing, sales, service, data, technology and compliance stakeholders.
* **Business Development Support:**
* Contribute to business cases, solution shaping and proposals; build reusable lifecycle marketing assets, accelerators and industry playbooks.

  

**Professional & Technical Skills:**

* **Customer Lifecycle Management and CRM experience** - ownership of lifecycle strategy, segmentation, campaign management, retention, loyalty, cross-sell and customer value programmes.
* **Relevant industry experience** across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms and/or Life Sciences, with an understanding of the customer journeys, commercial levers and regulatory considerations relevant to the industry.
* **Working experience with campaign, journey and decisioning platforms** such as Pega Customer Decision Hub, Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Unica or equivalent - able to brief, review and challenge platform configuration.
* **Marketing automation and journey design** - designing trigger-based, event-driven and real-time journeys across digital and assisted channels.
* **Analytical rigour** - comfortable with segmentation, propensity models, cohort analysis, control group design and incremental value measurement; able to work directly with data and analytics teams.
* **Consulting experience** providing strategic advice and solutions to organisations, with strong structuring and storytelling ability.
* **Project management skills** - the ability to plan, execute and oversee a workstream so it is completed on time, within budget and meeting the specified goals.
* **People management** - experience leading, coaching and developing small delivery teams.
* **Good to have:** exposure to Generative AI or AI implementation within a marketing, campaign, personalisation or customer engagement transformation.
* **Additional skills:**
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Proven success in navigating global matrixed environments and experience in client-facing roles.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, fast-paced and unstructured global environment.

**Additional Information:**

**Your experience counts!**

* MBA from a tier 1 institute.
* Overall experience of 10+ years, with at least:
* 6+ years in CRM, customer lifecycle management, campaign management, marketing automation or marketing transformation - in consulting and/or an industry marketing function.
* 4+ years of relevant industry experience across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms and/or Life Sciences, with direct ownership of customer growth, engagement, retention, loyalty or renewal outcomes.
* 2+ years managing a team or workstream.
* Good to have: hands-on project experience with GenAI, AI-powered personalisation or customer engagement transformation.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

description:
Architect - Enterprise Application - SAP N

**Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact?**  
At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  
  
If you thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  
  
Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  
Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

title: Senior Omnichannel Experience Design & Channel Manager
description:
Business Introduction
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Purpose of the Role**

Lead the design, execution, and optimization of omnichannel engagement strategies that enhance HCP experience, improve commercial effectiveness, and drive measurable business outcomes. The role will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Medical, and Commercial Excellence teams to translate business priorities into impactful customer journeys and scalable omnichannel programs.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Omnichannel Strategy & Experience Design**

* Define and evolve omnichannel engagement frameworks aligned to business priorities.

* Design customer-centric journeys using HCP insights, channel preferences, and engagement data.

* Drive personalization, segmentation, and next-best-action initiatives.

  
  

**Campaign Planning & Orchestration**

* Translate brand objectives into integrated omnichannel campaigns.

* Ensure seamless orchestration across field, digital, events, remote engagement, and content channels.

* Drive campaign reviews and continuous optimization based on performance insights.

  
  

**Analytics & Performance Management**

* Generate actionable insights from customer behavior, channel performance, and campaign outcomes.

* Identify improvement opportunities and drive execution of optimization plans.

  
  

**Channel & Capability Excellence**

* Lead deployment of new engagement capabilities, tools, and ways of working.

* Partner with global and local stakeholders to bring best practices and innovation into the market.

  
  

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Act as a strategic partner to Brand, Sales, Medical, and Leadership teams.

* Manage cross-functional priorities and ensure delivery excellence.

  
  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 8-12 years in Omnichannel, Digital Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Customer Experience, CRM, or Analytics.

* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and project leadership skills.

* Experience in Pharma, Healthcare, or other customer-centric industries preferred.

  
  

**Critical Competencies**

* Customer Centricity

* Strategic Thinking

* Data & Analytics Mindset

* Execution Excellence

* Cross-functional Influence

* Digital Innovation

* People Leadership

* Culture Ambassador

**Skills**

Business Acumen, Customer Experience (CX), Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Digital Marketing, Product Lifecycle, Scientific Literacy  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

  

**Job Family Group:**

IT\&S Group  

  

**Job Description:**

### **Job Description:**

### **Let me tell you about the role**


### **A Product Manager takes ownership of overall product and portfolio success, focusing on understanding customer needs and identifying opportunities to significantly improve its experience. This role involves defining product strategy, crafting a compelling vision, and driving the product lifecycle from concept to launch and scaling. Collaboration is key, working closely with engineers, designers, and business partners to deliver impactful solutions. The role requires a methodical approach to evaluating outcomes, ensuring alignment with bp’s financial, operational, and customer strategies. As a hands\-on contributor, the Product Manager manages day\-to\-day accountability and performance management to achieve product success.**


### **What you will deliver**


### **Business focused:**


* ### **Analytical and commercially focused, using data\-driven insights, metrics, and analytics to evaluate product performance and link outcomes to strategy**
* ### **Clearly define why we are pushing a product, considering market, competitor, technical, and operational aspects of bp’s strategy and vision**
* ### **Understand business and technical economic value, such as TCO, unit economics, NPV, ROIC, and other commercial measures**
* ### **Translate vision into strategic product roadmaps with an agile delivery approach in partnership with Tech while handling cyber, operational, and/or regulatory risks**
* ### **Plans and control costs associated with running a product, including collecting, analysing, and reporting cost/benefit information to more optimally provide value**

### **Human centered:**


* ### **Know and empathize with internal and/or external customer(s) needs to reinvent and innovate product solutions**
* ### **Integrate customer and partner feedback loops to ensure that product solutions and outcomes meet organizational needs**
* ### **Ability to coach team members and drive cross\-discipline problem solving to achieve business outcomes**

### **Technology driven:**


* ### **Use lean, iterative experiments and low\-fidelity prototyping to find signal, validate hypothesis, and iterate before moving to scale**
* ### **Collaborate with partners to define end\-state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant, and scalable technology solutions**
* ### **Engage with partners on data management, laying out how data is processed, stored, accessed, and protected**
* ### **Assess opportunities for reusing enterprise solutions and build new platforms with enterprise scalability in mind**
* ### **A keen curiosity about emerging tools and technologies**

### **Transformational leadership:**


* ### **Partner with team members on new working practices to drive collaboration and efficiency**
* ### **Balance customer insights, business goals, and industry opportunity spaces**
* ### **Influence and create alignment across a broad set of senior executives and partners to secure resources and overcome impediments to bringing products to market**

### **What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)**


### **At this level, the Product Manager is proficient in applying core product management principles to achieve business and customer goals. They play an active role in developing customer\-centric products, leveraging data insights to refine strategies and guide decision\-making. Responsibilities include managing technical and operational processes, defining product requirements, and addressing mid\-level challenges independently. Collaboration with cross\-functional teams is emphasized, ensuring alignment between business strategies and product outcomes. Their ability to balance customer needs, data insights, and operational excellence is evident in their contributions.**


### **Preferred experience:**


* ### **BS/MS in Business, Economics, STEM or equivalent experience**
* ### **Significant experience in product management, with a consistent track record of delivering successful products**

We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!**

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the Client**


Our client is a global leading, end\-to\-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not\-for\-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

**About Teamified**


Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-


scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and


accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high


performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,


designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

**About The Role**


We're looking for a mid\-level Product Manager to join us in working directly


with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual asks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.


This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.

**What you'll work on**

* Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer\-raised asks and requests
* Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
* Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
* Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform\-appropriate design
* Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
* Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
* Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
* Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs

  

**Requirements** **What you bring**

* 3\-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
* Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
* Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade\-offs behind them
* Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
* Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
* Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
* Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces

**Nice to have**

* Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
* Data\-driven decision making
* Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
* Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback

**Why this role matters**


This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.

 **Benefits**  

* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident Fund
* Gratuity


If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. **Apply now!**
